output.rationale: The requirement specifies metal-clad switchgear compliant with ANSI/IEEE C37.20.2 and arc-resistant construction per ANSI/IEEE C37.20.7. Among the candidates, the product 'CROWN-ARMV' from the CROWN business unit is an engineered-to-order (ETO) solution that meets these standards, as described in its text. Other candidates either do not match the technical specifications or are not relevant products for this requirement.
